{"edit_description":"Create a new single self-contained HTML file for a Todo app (filename: todo_zai-glm-5.3_01.html). All HTML, CSS, and JavaScript must be inline in this one file with no external dependencies. Requirements:

1. Add new todos: an input field plus Add button (also submits on Enter key). Empty/whitespace input is ignored.
2. Mark todos as complete: clicking a checkbox (or the item) toggles completion; completed items get line-through strikethrough styling and reduced opacity.
3. Delete todos: each item has a delete button (×) that removes it.
4. Filter: All / Active / Completed buttons (or links) that filter the visible list; active filter is highlighted; counts for remaining active items shown.
5. Persist to localStorage: todos array and current filter are saved on every change and restored on page load. Use a storage key like "todos-app" or similar. Wrap localStorage access in try/catch so it works even if storage is unavailable.

Quality expectations:
- Clean, modern, centered card layout with pleasant CSS (system font stack, subtle shadows, rounded corners, hover states).
- Semantic HTML (header, form, ul list, footer with filters).
- Clean vanilla JS: render function that rebuilds the list from state, event delegation on the list for toggle/delete, form submit handler for add, filter buttons update state and re-render.
- Escape HTML of todo text when rendering to avoid injection issues.
- Include a small "Clear completed" convenience action in the footer and an item count (e.g. "3 items left").
- A small app title like "Todo". Add the complete file including <!DOCTYPE html>, <html lang="en">, <head> with <meta charset>, <meta viewport>, and <title>Todo</title>.","path":"todo_zai-glm-5.3_01.html"}
